description:
The binary container header of `crates/gf2-core/src/io/` defines a compression flag and a checksum flag; readers and writers neither set nor interpret them.

## Background

The module documentation marked both flags as not implemented; the source-comment sweep restated that as the present limitation, and this issue tracks the work.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each flag is implemented with round-trip tests, including a corrupted-payload test for the checksum, or is removed from the format definition with the header layout otherwise unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Files written before the change load with identical contents, shown by a test over committed fixtures.
title: Implement or retire the compression and checksum flags of the binary format
